transcript: Speaker A (Narrator): उस दिन ऑफिस पार्टी से घर आई। पति ने कुछ नहीं बोला, सीधा कमरे में चला गया। मैं किचन में खड़ी थी। पता है सबसे बुरा क्या लगता है? जब तुम्हारा अपना आदमी तुमसे शर्मिंदा हो। उस दिन डिसाइड किया, अगली पार्टी में वो प्राउड होगा। [Returned home from the office party that day. Husband said nothing, went straight to the room. I stood in the kitchen. Do you know what feels worst? When your own man is ashamed of you. That day I decided, he will be proud at the next party.] Speaker B (HR): Hi, you must be Rahul's wife. So nice to finally meet you. What do you do? Speaker A: आई... होम... काम... घर में... [I... home... work... in house...] Speaker B: Oh, that's nice. Speaker A (Narrator): एचआर मुस्कुराई और दूसरे कपल से बात करने लग गई। [The HR smiled and started talking to another couple.] Speaker C (Boss's Wife): Hi dear, where are you from? Speaker A: मैं... जयपुर... से... [I... Jaipur... from...] Speaker C: Oh lovely, Jaipur is beautiful. Do you work or... Speaker A (Narrator): मीरा चुप। पति आता है... [Meera is silent. Husband comes...] Speaker D (Husband): Sorry, she's a bit tired today. Speaker D: आज अच्छा था पार्टी में? [Was it good at the party today?] Speaker A: हाँ... [Yes...] Speaker A (Narrator): घर जाते वक्त गाड़ी में साइलेंस, कोई और बात नहीं, दोनों चुप। उस रात सब सो गए। मैं बाथरूम में बैठकर रोई। सुंदर हूँ सब कहते हैं, पर सुंदर होने से क्या होता है जब मुंह से एक वर्ड नहीं निकलता। शादी की क्योंकि प्रीटी थी, पर पार्टी में प्रीटी से काम नहीं चलता, इंग्लिश चाहिए। उस रात फोन उठाया, इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड किया। एक रुपये का ट्रायल था। जनरल इंग्लिश शो खोला। हेलो से बात शुरू करें। एक लाख से ज्यादा लोग देख चुके थे। प्ले किया, इतना सिंपल था कि मुझे लगा हाँ, ये मैं कर सकती हूँ। रोज रात को पति सो जाता, मैं फोन पे सीखती। [Silence in the car on the way home, no other talk, both silent. That night everyone slept. I sat in the bathroom and cried. Everyone says I am beautiful, but what use is beauty when not a single word comes out of your mouth. He married me because I was pretty, but being pretty doesn't work at parties, you need English. That night I picked up my phone, downloaded the English Seekho app. There was a 1-rupee trial. Opened the General English show. Start talking with Hello. More than a lakh people had watched it. Played it, it was so simple that I felt yes, I can do this. Every night when my husband slept, I learned on my phone.] Speaker E (App/AI Coach): अपने बारे में बताओ। My name is Meera. I am from Jaipur. I am a homemaker. अपना नाम और सिटी इंग्लिश में कॉन्फिडेंटली बोलना। अपनी फैमिली इंट्रोड्यूस करें। My husband works at Infosys. We have been married for one year. [Tell about yourself. My name is Meera. I am from Jaipur. I am a homemaker. Speak your name and city confidently in English. Introduce your family. My husband works at Infosys. We have been married for one year.] Speaker A (Narrator): एआई कोच से प्रैक्टिस करती थी। [I used to practice with the AI coach.] Speaker A: Hi, nice to meet you. I am Meera. I am from Jaipur. I manage our home. I love cooking and reading. Speaker A (Narrator): गलत बोलती सुधार देती। 500 बार गलत बोला, 500 बार सुधारा। कभी नहीं बोली होममेकर है, तुझे इंग्लिश की क्या जरूरत। तीन महीने बाद दिवाली पार्टी थी ऑफिस की। पति ने बोला, चलना है? मैंने बोला, हाँ। [If I spoke incorrectly, it corrected me. Spoke wrong 500 times, corrected 500 times. It never said you are a homemaker, why do you need English. Three months later was the office Diwali party. Husband asked, want to go? I said, yes.] Speaker C: Meera, so good to see you again. How have you been? Speaker A: I have been great, thank you. We recently went to Udaipur for our anniversary. The Lake Palace was absolutely beautiful. Have you been there? Speaker C: Oh wow! No, I haven't. You have to tell me more. Speaker A (Narrator): पति दूर से देख रहा था। बॉस आया, बोला... [Husband was watching from afar. Boss came and said...] Speaker F (Boss): Rahul, your wife is very charming. Speaker A (Narrator): घर जाते वक्त गाड़ी में पति ने हाथ पकड़ा, बोला... [On the way home in the car, husband held my hand and said...] Speaker D: आज मुझे प्राउड फील हुआ। [Today I felt proud.] Speaker A: मैंने बोला, इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप। रोज 15 मिनट, बस इतना। इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो, जनरल इंग्लिश शो खोलो, एआई कोच से प्रैक्टिस करो। एक रुपये का ट्रायल है। अगली पार्टी में चुप मत बैठना, बोलो कॉन्फिडेंटली। पति का चेहरा देखना तब। [I said, English Seekho app. 15 minutes daily, just that. Download the English Seekho app, open the General English show, practice with the AI coach. There is a 1-rupee trial. Don't sit silent at the next party, speak confidently. See your husband's face then.] Speaker G (Outro): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
